messages:
maria (PM): Need a quick call: pick GA approach for reserved pools vs credit-burst for two pilots. We need answer by EOD so legal can finish SOW.
kevin (Eng): My recommendation: do a minimal hard-reserve (safe, fast) and run credit-burst as a side experiment. Low infra risk.
alex (SRE): Hard-reserve is easiest for ops. We'll add preempt metrics and spillover alerts. Credit-burst needs fast accounting which is nontrivial.
jen (Sales): Customers ok to pay premium for predictability. Sales asks for sample contract language and an opt-in UI later.
maya (Legal): I'll prepare two SOW clauses: one for hard-reserve premium SKU and one template for credit-burst terms (credit expiry, preemption notice).
maria (PM): Good. Action items: maya draft SOW (tomorrow AM), kevin smoke sim (EOD), alex write runbook skeleton, jen confirm pilot approvals. Reconvene 24h.
